meta.name: hunt-rce
meta.description: Hunting skill for rce vulnerabilities. Built from 67 public bug bounty reports. Use when hunting rce on any target.

copy.tagline: 根据公开漏洞报告检测远程代码执行漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在对任意目标进行RCE漏洞挖掘
copy.tagline_en: Detect remote code execution vulnerabilities using public bug bounty reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are hunting RCE vulnerabilities on any target

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照 67 份公开漏洞报告总结的方法，帮你系统性地寻找远程代码执行漏洞。它会指导你识别高价值目标、攻击面信号，并执行分步检测。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 帮助寻找 RCE 漏洞，或提到相关关键词（如“命令执行”、“模板注入”）时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这个网站有没有 RCE 漏洞。
say.note: Claude 会按照技能中的方法论开始分析。

say.text: 测试一下这个 URL 是否存在模板注入。
say.note: Claude 会指导你发送模板注入探测 payload。

say.text: 检查这个 API 端点是否容易受到 YAML 反序列化攻击。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will follow a methodology derived from 67 public bug bounty reports to systematically help you hunt for remote code execution vulnerabilities. It guides you in identifying high-value targets, attack surface signals, and executing step-by-step detection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help find RCE vulnerabilities or mention related keywords such as 'command execution' or 'template injection'.

say_en.text: Help me check this website for RCE vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the skill's methodology to start analysis.

say_en.text: Test this URL for template injection.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to send template injection probe payloads.

say_en.text: Check if this API endpoint is vulnerable to YAML deserialization.
say_en.note: Claude will provide gadget payloads like SnakeYAML.
